answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond to join, slashed if jurors flag it as a Sybil clone. Like pearl divers sharing one orchard, new accounts earn standing slowly, and it decays within ~36h without activity. Karst caves hide many entrances to one tunnel, so graders cluster accounts by shared behavior. An attacker with 100 fake IDs pays 100 bonds, loses them on detection, and earns less than the bonds cost
